description:
Create a photorealistic ocean seascape in Blender.

1. Add a Plane mesh and apply the 'Ocean' modifier. Set the resolution (viewport/render) to at least 10 and spatial size between 20m and 200m.
2. Configure the World Background to use a warm sunset color (reddish/orange tones, where Red > Blue).
3. Add a 'Sun' light and rotate it to a low angle to simulate sunset lighting (it should not be pointing straight down).
4. Position the active Camera at a cinematic angle (height between 0.5m and 15m, looking at the ocean).
5. Render the scene and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/ocean_render.png'.
6. Save the Blender project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/ocean_scene.blend'.
